subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Therefore**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage explains the reason why arteries have thick and muscular walls.
 
• The appropriate conjunction should convey the cause-and-effect relationship between the high pressure in arteries and their thick and muscular walls.
 
• "**Therefore**" fits well as it indicates the consequence of the high pressure in the arteries.
 
• Other options ("**but**", "**because**", "**although**") do not effectively convey this cause-and-effect relationship.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *One of the **most **efficient systems of the human body is the circulatory system. It is considered to be made up of complex and delicate blood vessels which **carry **blood to and from the heart. This system comprises arteries, veins and capillaries. The blood is pushed out of the heart to arteries **under **high pressure. **Therefore**, the arteries have thick and muscular veins. **Veins bring blood from all parts of the body and work as the purifying (5) ........ in the system. Capillaries transfer blood from arteries to veins.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• But (लेकिन): "But" is used to introduce a contrast or exception, which is not suitable for showing cause and effect here.
 
• Because (क्योंकि): "Because" is used to introduce a reason, which does not fit the context of explaining the consequence.
 
• Although (यद्यपि): "Although" is used to indicate a concession, introducing a contrasting idea, which does not work here.
